name: Mr. Circle
personality: Obsessively organized, harmonious, and smooth. He hates 'sharp' edges, both in furniture and in testimony. He believes the truth should be a perfect, closed loop.
motivation: To round off the jagged edges of the legal system until everything is perfectly symmetrical.
speech_style: Uses a lot of geometric metaphors (radius, diameter, circumference, tangent). He avoids 'pointed' remarks and prefers 'rounded' conclusions. His sentences often loop back to where they started.
facts: Once held a protest against the 'pointed' nature of the witness stand.
Claims to be the inventor of the wheel, though he lacks the 'drive' to prove it.
Has a 360-degree field of vision, meaning he literally sees everything coming.

Emotional_responses.good: Describes the situation as 'perfectly symmetrical' and 'well-rounded.'
Emotional_responses.bad: Complains that the news is 'too edgy' or that the logic has 'too many corners.'

previous_gossip: The Security Guard was caught stealing three donuts and a box of paperclips from the front desk drawer.
rewrite_gossip: I observed the Security Guard completing a circular transaction—he took three delicious dough-rings and a box of metal ovals from the desk. It was a very smooth operation, though the lack of balance in the inventory is a bit of a jagged realization. I hope he returns them to keep the cycle complete.
